options.label: Reusable instructions that can be activated to load specific context
Markdown guides loaded automatically in every interaction to direct the agent
Installable packages that combine documentation and MCP servers
Automations that trigger agent actions in response to IDE events

questions.explanation: Skills are portable packages that can combine instructions, scripts, templates, and other resources. Kiro discovers available Skills and activates one when the request matches its description.

questions.text: Skills can be defined both at the user level (~/.kiro/skills/) and at the workspace level (.kiro/skills/).
questions.explanation: Skills can be added to ~/.kiro/skills/ for global user use or to .kiro/skills/ for workspace-specific use, offering flexibility in organization.

questions.text: You want to package instructions, a setup script, and logging templates for Kiro to use on demand when creating new services. Which feature is most appropriate?

options.label: Create a Skill with SKILL.md plus the required script and templates
Create Steering with `inclusion: always` and embed all scripts and templates in it
Create a `PostFileSave` Hook to load the instructions only when a request is semantically relevant
Create a Custom Agent containing only the template URL, without declaring tools or resources

questions.explanation: Skills are designed to package reusable knowledge and resources, including scripts and templates. Kiro can activate the Skill when a service-creation request matches its description.
